style: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual transparent PNG game icon for Cat-Cook. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match their warm Japanese picture-book flat gouache, colored-pencil grain INSIDE objects, thick soft wobbly dark-brown #2b211b outline, chunky rounded silhouette. Muted warm cream #fff8ec, red #d7263d, gold #f5b82e and green #3fa66b. Simple flat base plus one shadow shape and restrained cream highlight. Slight three-quarter top-down view, centered isolated subject fills 80% of square canvas with generous even fully transparent margins. Readable at 48px. Genuine transparent background. No text, letters, numbers, logos, food faces, backdrop, tile, cast shadow, gradients, gloss, 3D or emoji style. Subject:

assets.subject: Japanese shoyu ramen in one small cream ceramic bowl with red rim and tiny cream blossom decoration. Clearly transparent deep amber-brown soy broth, yellow wavy noodles, TWO round brown chashu slices with pale meat spirals and chopped green scallions. No egg, no corn, no extra dishes.

Japanese shio ramen in one small cream ceramic bowl with red rim. Clearly pale clear straw-gold salt broth, yellow wavy noodles, a few rectangular tan menma bamboo-shoot strips and green scallions. Light transparent broth distinct from brown soy ramen and milky pork ramen. No pork slices, no egg.

assets.subject: Japanese miso ramen in one small cream ceramic bowl with red rim. Opaque warm ochre-brown miso broth, yellow noodles, a small pile of pale bean sprouts with yellow tips and green scallions. Distinct golden-brown cloudy soup, no pork slices, no egg, no corn.

Japanese tonkotsu ramen in one small cream ceramic bowl with red rim. Opaque milky ivory pork-bone broth, thin yellow noodles, two brown chashu slices, HALF a soft boiled egg with golden yolk and green scallions. Clearly white creamy broth, no orange miso broth.

Japanese tsukemen as ONE combined isolated icon: a cream plate with a neat mound of thick yellow cooked noodles, and a SEPARATE smaller cream dipping bowl beside it containing concentrated dark-brown dipping broth, a chashu slice, menma strips and scallions. Both vessels red edged, noodles stay on plate, not submerged. Keep both vessels large and close together for 48px legibility.

Japanese egg fried rice, a compact golden dome on one cream red-rimmed plate. Distinct small yellow egg pieces and green scallions among loose golden rice grains. No seasoning shaker, no packets, no meat, no cutlery. Simple freshly wok-fried rice dish.

A small pile of several short rectangular tan golden-brown seasoned menma bamboo-shoot strips with simple lengthwise fibrous lines, one leaning across the others. No whole green bamboo, no leaves, no plate, no ramen.

A small cream ceramic handled stock pitcher with red rim, filled with opaque milky ivory pork-bone broth, clear visible pale liquid surface and one tiny cream steam curl. Concentrate on the creamy white soup ingredient. No noodles, no toppings, no bones, no text.

One Japanese convenience-store triangular onigiri, cream rice and dark green nori visible inside a simple clear triangular wrapper with folded seams. One tiny unlettered red pull tab. No plate or leaf.

Two triangular white-bread egg sandwiches, pale golden egg filling visibly between crustless cream bread slices, together in a clear triangular convenience-store wrapper with a tiny plain green seal. No text, no plate.

One short rounded clear plastic bottle of amber-green ready-to-drink Japanese tea with a green screw cap and a simple unlettered cream label showing a small green tea-leaf pictogram. No cup, no letters.

One short squat Japanese canned coffee, warm brown cylindrical metal can with cream top and bottom rims, simple cream panel with a tiny brown coffee-bean pictogram. Closed pull-tab on top. No cup, no lettering or numbers.

One small puffy convenience-store potato-chip bag, muted red and warm gold packaging, crimped top and bottom, a cream unlettered panel with a simple golden potato-chip pictogram. Two golden curved potato chips beside it. No text, no logos.

One small packaged ice cream cup, cream-and-muted-blue paper cup with the edge of a peeled-back lid revealing pale vanilla ice cream with a simple soft scoop shape. Tiny cream blossom pictogram on cup. No writing, no cone, no spoon.

One plump ivory steamed Japanese meat bun with pleated pinched top on a small square of cream paper, a small cutaway section clearly showing brown minced-meat filling. No plate, no dumpling crescent, no text.
